evidence: The thickness of layers up to 100 nm was determined from ellipsometric measurements. Parameters Δ and Ψ, on the basis of which thickness was calculated, were recorded on a laser ellipsometer with wavelength λ = 623.8 nm and angle of light beam incidence on a sample Θ = 68 °30'. The elemental composition of the obtained nanostructures was determined through X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) by comparing the experimental values of the binding energy (Eb) and the standard values for this compound. The structure of layers and their orientation were controlled by means of electron- and microdiffraction using an EVR-100 high-resolution electron diffraction camera and an EMV-100BR electron microscope.
